name: GWASSumStats_list_studies
description: List GWAS studies that have deposited full summary statistics with the EBI GWAS Catalog. The API uses start/size pagination and does not expose a total count: continue with metadata.next_start while metadata.has_more is true; the exact total is known only on the last page.

start.description: Zero-based start offset (default 0). Continue with metadata.next_start.

name: GWASSumStats_get_trait_studies
description: Get GWAS studies with deposited summary statistics for a specific EFO trait. Use start/size pagination and continue with metadata.next_start while has_more is true; this API gives an exact total only once the last page is reached. Use EFO IDs such as EFO_0000249 or EFO_0001359.

trait_id.description: EFO trait ontology ID (e.g., 'EFO_0000249' for Alzheimer disease, 'EFO_0001645' for coronary heart disease, 'EFO_0001359' for type 2 diabetes).

start.description: Zero-based start offset (default 0). Continue with metadata.next_start.

name: GWASSumStats_get_region_associations
description: Query full GWAS summary statistics for variants in a chromosomal region. Returns variant-level association data in the upstream stable order. Use start/size pagination and continue with metadata.next_start while has_more is true. The API does not expose a total count before the last page, so metadata reports an exact total only when pagination is exhausted.

bp_lower.description: Start position of the region (GRCh38 coordinates).

bp_upper.description: End position of the region (GRCh38 coordinates).

p_upper.description: Maximum p-value threshold (default 5e-8 for genome-wide significance). Use larger values like 0.001 to include suggestive hits.

study_accession.description: Filter by specific GWAS study accession (e.g., 'GCST002245'). Get study IDs from GWASSumStats_list_studies or GWASSumStats_get_trait_studies.

start.description: Zero-based start offset (default 0). Continue with metadata.next_start.
